name: Purepuri 3 Hoken'i no Himitsu Lesson
original_name: プレプリ3 保健医の秘密レッスン
source:
Shizuka is the most popular and beautiful nurse at the school.
She has an aromatic adultness and mysterious, indescribable charm.

The protagonist was among the many pubescent boys attracted to her.
He watches her over a year and his passion grows, until the kiss of fate...
There starts the secret sexual lessons of the two. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE068443.html]DLsite English[/url]]
